newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador Congress expects budget sent by Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador Congress expects budget sent by Wednesday.

text.p: Ecuador's Congress said Tuesday the government has until Wednesday to send its 1997 budget proposal to Congress.
Carlos Vidal, president of the budget committee, said as soon as Congress receives the budget, various parliamentary groups would analyze the package.
Vidal said Congress has until December 31 to approve the budget.
Government sources said the budget proposal would be sent to Congress on Wednesday, adding that some 48 percent of the budget's expenditure would go to paying public debt.
